exact_open_question: Given that EXEC148 provides validated latency value but incurs materialization and residency costs, which system resource should create, host, and maintain the execution representation, and under what workload lifetime/reuse conditions does each placement dominate?

decision_reframe.objective: Determine when a B placement has lower total system cost than A without assuming any particular unused hardware resource is beneficial.
decision_reframe.non_objective: Do not search for a single globally optimal kernel or force A+B composition.

current_reference_placement.lifetime_observed: one materialization before measured campaign, retained for the campaign
current_reference_placement.note: This is a measured reference placement, not an architecture winner.

critical_architecture_distinction.statement: Creator domain and residency domain are independent axes. On the current UMA host, labels such as CPU, GPU and RAM cannot be treated as mutually exclusive physical placement choices.
critical_architecture_distinction.consequence: A GPU-created EXEC148 image and a CPU-created EXEC148 image may still reside in the same physical shared-memory pool; B1 must account separately for creator cost, transfer/copy cost, execution accessibility, contention and lifetime.

total_cost_model.baseline: Total_A(H,S)=H*L_A(S) for the incremental B-vs-A decision, plus only costs common to both paths.
total_cost_model.dominance_rule: B placement P dominates A only when Total_B(P,H,S) < Total_A(H,S) and correctness, capacity, accessibility and resource-contention constraints all pass.
total_cost_model.H: Total future decode-token reuse of the same valid EXEC148 image before eviction/invalidation.
total_cost_model.S: Relevant runtime/resource state: memory pressure, concurrent work, power/thermal state, model lifetime and device availability.
exclusions: Scientific validation wall time is not a deployment/runtime materialization cost.
Historical arm-0 latency is no longer the B1 decision baseline.
Do not treat unused nominal TOPS as available execution value without a data-access and scheduling path.

P1_GPU_CREATE_IN_PLACE.hypothesis: GPU may create EXEC148 directly where it is consumed and may reduce host materialization or copy cost.
required_before_execution: proof it does not steal more critical-path GPU time than it saves

P2_NPU_CREATE_OR_MAINTAIN.hypothesis: An otherwise underused NPU could absorb representation work if it can read source Q4_K and produce an execution image accessible to the Vulkan GPU at acceptable handoff cost.
required_before_execution: no assumption from vendor TOPS alone

P3_OFFLINE_PREMATERIALIZED_SIDECAR.hypothesis: Move creation out of inference runtime by storing a versioned EXEC148 sidecar and pay storage/load cost instead of runtime transform cost.

P4_OTHER_ENGINE.hypothesis: DMA/DSP/audio or another engine is admissible only if it exposes programmable transformation or useful data movement and can participate in the required memory path.
P4_OTHER_ENGINE.rule: Do not name or benchmark a device merely because it is idle; first prove capability and accessible dataflow.

decision_variables_to_observe_or_bound: ability to overlap creation with otherwise unavoidable work
resource contention with prefill/decode/KV or other system activity
architecture_decision_outputs: For each feasible placement class, a dominance region over reuse horizon/resource state versus A.
A fallback rule when B is not yet amortized or cannot be kept resident.
A residency/lifetime policy for B independent of its creator.
A capability gate that rejects speculative hardware resources before performance experiments.
An explicit domain-of-validity boundary; no universal placement winner is required.
falsification_and_kill_rules: Kill a placement class before implementation if the resource cannot access required source/destination data without an unavoidable copy whose lower bound removes plausible advantage.
Kill a placement class before performance work if it cannot preserve the exact EXEC148 semantic tuple.
Kill a placement class if minimum unavoidable creator+transfer+maintenance cost cannot beat A for any plausible reuse horizon under the target regime.
Do not rescue a failed placement by changing EXEC148 semantics, A baseline, workload, or decision metric post outcome.

immediate_next_study.question: For P0/P1/P2/P3/P4, which placement classes are physically/software feasible on the current platform, what data path would each require, and what optimistic lower bound on creation+handoff cost determines whether a runtime experiment is worth opening?
immediate_next_study.output: feasibility matrix + cost-bound ledger + shortlist of only decision-relevant placements
